ledger: Sheldon Cooper | Green and white striped shirt, facing forward/center | Green and white striped shirt, facing left profile | Turns body to the left and approaches a door
Door and Wall | Wooden door with glass panels and clock behind actor | Solid wooden door with light switches on adjacent wall | Background elements change inconsistently during turn

findings.description: When Sheldon turns to face the door at 00:08, the door appears to be solid wood without glass panels, whereas the door behind him in the opening shots (00:00-00:06) clearly features glass panes near the top. Additionally, a bank of light switches appears on the wall to the left of the door frame at 00:08, which was not visible in the previous framing where only a coat hook was seen on that side.
